title: An upload or list save can write while the first read has failed: they do not read the load gate
evidence: Done 2026-11-14: decision Option A, no gate; no production change. The list saves and an upload stay ungated, and that is safe: before the first read is shown the window is small but not proven empty: for a returning user `now.fullForm ||= opensFullForm(...)` (widget-src/src/hooks/useOnboarding.ts:165; packages/health-core/src/mappings.ts:476-479) can open the whole form, with its lists and both upload buttons (widget-src/src/components/MyHealth.tsx:168,271), in the first render, while the lists are still [] (widget-src/src/hooks/useRecordState.ts:45-47); the mount effect fills them, reusing the mount read so it reaches showRecord with no await (HealthTool.tsx:162-169), so the only window is between the first commit and its effects, and no test drives a list change there; when the first read fails part-way (the mirror throws after showRecord, HealthTool.tsx:169-175) the record is shown, and these writes are keyed upserts or append-only rows that merge (packages/health-core/src/merge.ts), so no row is lost; a keyed upsert is last-writer-wins, so after a lasting failure (below) a list save from a stale screen can replace another writer's newer value for that key. A second caller outside the form: ChatEdits calls handleMedicationChange for an applied chat proposal (widget-src/src/components/ChatEdits.tsx:158-159) and for its Undo (:244). Neither reads the load gate (useChatEdits gets no loaded, HealthTool.tsx:517-519); Undo checks only eraseUnshown (:244), and the proposal's escalation reset is worked out against the store's saved list (loadLatestMeasurementsSync, :153), not the screen's. The same holds for it: keyed upserts that merge, last-writer-wins. One inconsistency, kept: an upload's start (handleUploadStart, HealthTool.tsx:344-351) commits the vitals matrix (StartingInfoVitals.tsx:399) and runs handleSaveLongitudinal, which calls flushProfile (useLongitudinalSave.ts:163; useProfileSave.ts:65 reads no load gate), so it saves a profile edit that autosave would not (useProfileSave.ts:118). The blood-test matrix commit stays gated (BloodTestTimeline.tsx:320-323). US-34 AC4 says so. Pin: HealthTool.record-read-pins.test.tsx 'US-34 AC4 (H102): the first read fails part-way; a medication change still saves and shows' (fails with the medication save gated on loaded: expected 20 to be 40). Open edge (owner ruling 2026-11-14), checked against the code and corrected: a record read (loadLatestMeasurements) that throws, and keeps throwing, throws in the page's first render (the mount read, HealthTool.tsx:97, loadLatestMeasurementsSync during render), so the ErrorBoundary (widget-src/standalone/app.tsx:56) replaces the whole tool: the person sees 'Something went wrong' and 'Please refresh the page to try again', with no form and no onboarding questions. So the feared path (answer the four questions, open the full form, then screeningWrites / medicationWrites in packages/health-core/src/input-form.ts compute their clears and resets against empty lists, leaving a recorded screening or medication set while the screen shows it cleared) is not reachable that way; a one-off probe test (deleted) confirmed the error panel. Still open: the person is stuck on that panel until the read works; nothing is written. A lasting failure later in the first read (the lab read, loadLabValues, the 'lasting reason' pin) is different: the record and lists are shown, then every re-read fails, so the lists go stale, not empty; a screening or medication answer then computes its clears (screeningWrites / medicationWrites) against that stale list and saves ungated, so a key another writer changed since can be overwritten or left uncleared while the screen shows this tab's answer. Rare; open. Was: the five load-gated save paths read loaded = read === 'shown' (useProfileSave, useOnboarding, hasUnsavedLongitudinal, InputPanel autoSaveGate, BloodTestTimeline saveDisabledByLoad); the lab upload's handleSaveLongitudinal and useListSaves (medications, screenings, supplements) never read it. Found by the adversary on PR 1713 (H37, F2). Related: H52.
